metric_contract.text_accuracy_scope: prose stratum only, to avoid confusing table HTML/formula LaTeX with text OCR errors
metric_contract.cer: Levenshtein(NFKC(text) with whitespace removed) / normalized GT character count; case and punctuation preserved, raw CER may exceed 1; empty/error prediction has CER=1.
metric_contract.wer: English prose only; NFKC then Unicode word-or-punctuation tokens, case preserved.
metric_contract.usable_page: Custom pilot rule fixed before scores: CER<=0.10 and prediction length >=0.80*GT length. Includes all prose failures in denominator; not an industry standard or a semantic correctness guarantee.
metric_contract.structure: Table/figure/formula gold regions preserved; TEDS, CDM, region recall and image semantic accuracy are NOT computed by this pilot.
metric_contract.aggregation: Equal-weight macro CER and edit-sum/GT-character-sum micro CER; language and source-page counts reported. Variants are paired observations, not independent new documents.

adapter: Docling tree order; all ContentLayers; TextItem.text, table-cell text for non-prose only; no Markdown wrapper or answer-based cleanup.
execution: isolated cold subprocess per input; all exceptions/timeouts included as empty predictions; local offline weights; no API keys inherited
